test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

I ___________ to many countries to find the source of true happiness.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2** 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word '**travelled'** means to make a journey, typically of some length. (यात्रा की)

 
 
• **Example: **She has** travelled **to many exotic places around the world.
